detailed_descriptions.en: Build a local car wash into a massive detailing empire! Master advanced cleaning techniques with vibrant active foams, beat the clock for extra tips, and buy or lease new properties. Play it clean or risk everything with high-paying shady deals and secret backroom plantations. THE SATISFYING ART OF DETAILING A multi-million dollar business always starts with a single blast of high-pressure water. There is a satisfying, therapeutic beauty in watching layers of caked road dirt instantly vanish under a master touch. Perfecting the core cleaning loop at a modest local car wash builds the foundation for total city dominance. Transforming everyday vehicles into spotless, gleaming showroom masterpieces is where the true addiction begins. VIBRANT FOAMS AND TICKING CLOCKS Standard rinses belong in the past. Slathering cars in thick layers of pink, blue, or premium white active foam melts away tough grime before heavy-duty pressure washers deliver the final finish. Detailing can be handled at a relaxed, therapeutic pace, but completing tutorials unlocks intense time-constraint challenges. Blasting away randomized grime under a strict clock rewards flawless, high-speed optimization with large cash multipliers and bonus tips. THE REWARD OF A PERFECT JOB Flawless execution unlocks the ultimate perk: climbing into the driver’s seat of a freshly detailed, gleaming machine for a well-deserved spin. Hearing the engine roar to life after a perfect clean delivers pure satisfaction before handing back the keys. Tracking daily success through financial performance stats provides the capital needed for real estate expansion. Reinvested profits buy, clean, furnish, sell, or lease a massive commercial network of secondary car wash locations for passive daily income. SHADY BACKROOMS AND PLAZA DISTRACTIONS When legitimate washing isn’t enough, high-stakes alternative paths await in the shadows. Accepting optional underground packages from sketchy clients or converting secondary properties into secret plant plantations offers rapid black-market capital at an increased risk. When management stress boils over under the dynamic day-and-night cycle and random event cards, the surrounding plaza offers the perfect escape. Chaotic physics-based mini-games let detailers blow off steam by shooting at flying targets with a toy pistol, mastering trash-bag basketball, or collecting runaway shopping carts in full-driving mode. KEY FEATURES Advanced Detailing Mastery Enjoy 14 cleaning mechanics! Clean car bodies, squeegee windows, scrub floor mats on specialized grates, and apply premium tire dressing wax. Chemical Arsenal Upgrade to 3 distinct types of pressure washers and deploy thick white, blue, or pink active foams. The Ticking Clock Choose between a relaxed, therapeutic simulation or intense time-attack challenges for massive tip multipliers. Unique Contracts Handle orders, intense, timed challenges, high-paying, shady deliveries, and massive, multi-step mega jobs. Underground Hustles Safely store, hold, and transport mysterious contraband packages for sketchy clients to earn rapid revenue. Real Estate Monopoly Rent, buy, clean, furnish, sell, or lease out secondary facilities for passive daily income. Backroom Operations Run a secret, high-profit plant plantation inside newly acquired properties to rapidly boost capital. A Living Sandbox Navigate a complete Day/Night system, random event cards, and post-shift financial performance statistics. Plaza Mini-Games Take a break to shoot flying targets, throw trash bags, or jump into driving mode to collect runaway shopping carts.
